headline: Police raid home of 'Grenade Babu' in Khulna, brother Joni detained
summary: Mahamudun Chowdhury (Joni) was picked up during a special joint operation targeting top terrorists and gang leaders in the city.
details: Police conducted a raid on the home of Roni Chowdhury Babu, known as 'Grenade Babu', a top listed terrorist and life-term convict in Khulna. During the operation on Friday afternoon, his brother Mahamudun Chowdhury, also known as Joni, was detained.
caption:
A top terrorist's home raided in Khulna. His brother Joni is now in police custody.

headline_marked: UK lawyer of Bangladeshi origin [[license suspended for 6 months]] over ChatGPT case
headline: UK lawyer of Bangladeshi origin license suspended for 6 months over ChatGPT case
summary: Muhammad Mujibur Rahman was suspended by the Bar Standards Board after citing a non-existent court case generated by AI in a legal filing.
details: The Bar Standards Board (BSB) of the UK has suspended the legal license of Muhammad Mujibur Rahman, a lawyer of Bangladeshi origin, for six months.
The suspension follows a controversy where Rahman cited a non-existent court case in an appeal draft, which was later revealed to be generated by ChatGPT.

The Upper Tribunal (Immigration and Asylum Chamber) previously ruled that Rahman's behavior was unprofessional, noting that he cited a case titled 'Y (China) [2010] EWCA Civil 116' that did not exist in reality.
When questioned by the court, Rahman admitted that the citation came from ChatGPT and that he had failed to verify its authenticity before submitting it to the court.

Judges Justice Dove and Judge Livesley stated that a lawyer's primary duty is to provide truthful and accurate information, calling the use of unverified AI-generated data 'dangerous and unprofessional'.
The BSB stated that the suspension was ordered by an independent interim suspension panel on May 18, and another hearing will be place before the six-month period ends to reconsider the matter.
While the tribunal found that the case was not intentionally fabricated, they noted that the behavior damaged public trust in the legal profession and the court.
The BSB declined to provide further specific details on the nature of the allegations, citing confidentiality protocols for ongoing proceedings.
